Frequently Asked Questions

What is Tap Tap Sorry?
Tap Tap Sorry is a stress-relief game. When you're feeling down, you can put a character's picture on the screen, tap it, and they'll keep saying "sorry" to you. It's a fun and harmless way to release negative emotions!
How do I play?
Select a character from the gallery, then tap the screen to interact. Each tap triggers a playful response. The game lasts 30 seconds — try to see how many taps you can get!
Can I use my own photo?
Yes! You can import a custom photo from your photo library to use as the character image. Just tap "Import" in the character selection screen.
Can I change the voice?
Yes, you can choose between Male and Female voices. You can also import a custom audio file from your device to use a sound of your choice.
The app is free?
Yes, Tap Tap Sorry is completely free to download and play. There are no hidden charges or subscriptions.
I found a bug or have a suggestion. What should I do?
Please email us at 348248797@qq.com with details about the issue or your suggestion. We appreciate all feedback!
